headline: Graph-guided red-teaming finds more harmful cross-service paths in a simulated personal-agent ecosystem
summary: The October 2026 X-AgentRed preprint uses a graph of tool effects and execution preconditions to generate cross-service red-team scenarios, then uses execution feedback to diversify successful paths and repair blocked ones. In one evaluation run per configuration across four target agents in a simulated ecosystem of 30 services and 914 tools, the authors report a 19.2% harmful-path rate, versus 10.5% for STAC and 2.7% for TRACE; average tool coverage is 41.5%, versus 13.9% and 23.7%. These are paper-reported simulator results, not estimates of real-world agent risk.
